description: Point-in-time per-merchant wallet balance for a marketplace (no date range), one row per merchant. Dimensions: os_client_id, merchant_id, merchant_name. Returns the raw remaining_budget_amount_usd (USD) plus the marketplace conversion_factor (USD->marketplace currency); the Python layer computes remaining_balance = (usd * factor) when usd >= 0.01 else 0. Not aggregated, so it carries a placeholder metric.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level passthrough report with no aggregated metric; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.clients AS clients JOIN reporting.marketplace_clients AS mc ON clients.agency_id = mc.agency_id JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND clients.seller_id IS NOT NULL AND clients.seller_id != '' AND mc.marketplace_client_id != clients.client_id AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
